The '''Virgillian Free Alignment Starfleet''' was the military arm of the [[Virgillian Free Alignment/Legends|Virgillian Free Alignment]]. Formed during the [[Virgillian Civil War]], the Starfleet was aligned to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The Alliance donated several [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruisers]] to the Starfleet. A twenty-two [[Starship/Legends|starship]] force, including the ''[[Flurry]]'' and the ''[[Dukedoom]]'' under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tessa Manchisco]], fought as part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
